observation.command:
cd /workspace/.devcontainer && cat > /tmp/kc-verbose2.yml <<'EOF'
services:
  kc:
    command: ['start-dev', '--import-realm', '--http-port=8180', '--verbose', '--spi-theme-static-max-age=-1', '--spi-theme-cache-themes=false', '--spi-theme-cache-templates=false', '--log-console-color=false']
EOF
docker compose -f /tmp/kc-verbose.yml -f /tmp/kc-verbose2.yml -p kcrepro up -d --force-recreate kc 2>&1 | tail -2
sleep 75
docker logs kcrepro-kc-1 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|exception|import" | head -30
